title: Santa Rosa Beach Home w/ Pool, Golf Cart & Bikes Sleeps 14
meta_description: The Blue Pearl: 4BR/3.5BA 30A retreat with private pool, hot tub, golf cart, bikes, coastal décor, double workspaces & near beach, dining & shopping. Sleeps 14.
description_expanded: About* Large private pool with covered patio and ample seating * Complimentary 6 seater golf cart * Close to two beach accesses * Two large adult bikes * Great location close to shopping, dining, and entertainment * Large open concept living areas with ample seating * Coastal decor * Fully stocked kitchen * Outdoor grill * Double workspaces * Fiber high speed internet with eero, access by pool * Four backpack beach chairs and an umbrella * Ample Parking Welcome to The Blue Pearl, your coastal 30A vacation retreat, where every detail is thoughtfully curated to envelop you in comfort, luxury, and fun. Ideal for families and friends to gather, this four-bedroom, 3.5-bath home sleeps up to 14 guests, features a private pool, and has ample parking for all guests. As you step inside, you'll immediately notice the serene, inviting atmosphere and open concept living space. Relax in the cozy, plush furnishings, bathed in natural light, as you spend time with loved ones. The fully equipped kitchen beckons with its modern appliances and sleek design. Soft blue, white, gray, and pearl hues offer coastal tranquility throughout the home. Explore the surrounding 30A area with ease, thanks to the home's 6-seater golf cart. Whether off to the beach or cruising the neighborhood, the golf cart ensures every adventure is within reach. If you prefer to bike or need more golf carts, our trusted concierge partners will be happy to rent you any additional gear you may need for your stay. Head outside, where your private oasis awaits. Take a refreshing dip in the pool or soothe your cares away in the bubbling hot tub. Lounge on the covered patio featuring plush furniture with a cocktail in hand—you are on vacation, after all! Unwind in the main floor bedrooms, where serenity reigns supreme. The primary bedroom suite welcomes you with its king-sized bed and ensuite bathroom, evoking a sense of seaside serenity. In the second bedroom, enjoy an ensuite bathroom and remote working space. Plus, laundry on the first floor offers the convenience of being at home. As you head to the second floor, you'll notice the loft area offers a cozy retreat with a sleeper sofa and double workspace adorned with tasteful accents in soft hues of blue and white. The loft is the perfect spot for those needing to remote work or for kids to play! Two queen bedrooms await, each offering luxurious comfort and a peaceful atmosphere that invites rest and relaxation. Each queen bedroom offers a separate, private space with daybeds and trundles for additional sleeping arrangements. One of the queen bedrooms features an additional daybed and trundle in the same room, perfect for the kids to gather together. With its inviting atmosphere, luxurious amenities, and thoughtful decor, The Blue Pearl is more than just a place to stay—it's a 30A vacation property where cherished memories are ready to be made. Experience the 30A way of life at this beautiful coastal retreat.
